event: "Eh, thanks, but they said the fangs would be enough," Nala tells Tam.

memory.fact: Tam Hobb shrugs off the refused barrow and offers Nala a loaf and a cup of ale for the road.

event: "Just cut off the head to make sure it was dead."

memory.fact: Nala left the Weir Wyrm's head on the weir apron with its carcass.

event: She spins up a water blade and works it around the jaw; both fangs come free clean and whole.

changes.note: A water blade at the jaw spends 10 mana

memory.fact: Two fangs, each a hand long and about a pound, come from the wyrm's jaw with a water blade; easy.

event: Each is a hand long, hooked and yellow-white. She wraps them and stows them in her pack.

changes.note: Nala cuts the wyrm's two fangs free and stows them in her pack

memory.fact: Nala cut the wyrm's two fangs out whole: hooked, yellow-white, each a hand long.
Nala wrapped the Weir Wyrm's two fangs in a scrap of cloth and carries them in her pack.

event: She draws water and fire together into a gentle steam and plays it over her skin and clothes.

memory.fact: Water and fire woven make steam; air and fire woven make a hot, drying wind.
A gentle steam weave played over her own skin and clothes cleans them without scalding; no roll.

event: Bile, blood and river muck roll off her in a hot cloud; the sting in her forearms eases.

memory.fact: Steam washes the wyrm bile off Nala's arms, and the nettle sting fades within the hour.

event: Then air and fire: a hot wind wraps her for three minutes and leaves her dry.

changes.note: Steam and hot wind cost more than the few minutes give back

memory.fact: Nala's water-and-fire steam washes her clean; an air-and-fire wind dries her in three minutes.
A steam clean or a hot-wind dry costs 10 mana a minute; each takes about three minutes.

event: Tam Hobb snorts, half a laugh. "Handy trick. I'll be grinding by two, then."

changes.note: The miller and barge crews watch her work steam and wind

memory.fact: Seeing Nala steam herself clean, Tam Hobb calls it a handy trick and says he'll be grinding by two.

event: The crews whistle and start back up the bank toward their barges.

memory.fact: Once Nala has the fangs, the barge crews whistle and head back up the bank to their barges.

event: Jory lingers, eyes on Dickon's belt in Nala's hand, and slowly holds out his own.

memory.fact: Jory lingers, eyes on Dickon's belt in Nala's hand, and slowly holds out his own hand.
Jory eyes Dickon's belt in her hand and asks for it, to take to Dickon's mother at Brennock Ford.
